//: Pinned dependency versions for every Edge Function.
These handlers run with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in scope, so a malicious release in any of these
packages — or a compromise of the CDN serving them — executes with full
database access and live payment credentials. Floating specifiers
('@2', '@14', or no version at all) re-resolve on every deploy, which
means the code that ships is whatever the registry served that morning.
Versions are exact. stripe stays on 14.x deliberately: the handler is
written against that major's API surface. Bump these consciously, and
re-run `deno check` against each function afterwards.
